name: Tool — Memory (status-only)
description: `MemorySearchPreviewTool` would let a Prompt Agent search a memory store while the host orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. This covers persisted user or conversation memory as a tool, separate from the agent's model routing.
notes:
Not yet probed against Foundry because public SDK/docs support is not stable in the current environment. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/memory-usage. See `test.py` for the `MEMORY_STORE_ID` wiring.

Memory is not in the official BYOM-supported tools list: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations.
